Indian Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in India comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Indian documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Regional Passport Office6500–24000 INR
Driving Licencethe Regional Transport Office4500–18000 INR
ID CardUIDAI3500–13500 INR
Green Cardthe Foreigners Regional Registration Office12000–40000 INR
Visaan Indian mission5500–20000 INR
Residence Permitthe Foreigners Regional Registration Office11000–36000 INR

Two checks specific to India

  • Check the licence for the RTO code and the state smart card format and confirm the licence number structure.
  • Confirm the passport emblem printing and the machine-readable zone.

Local red flag

  • A licence bearing an RTO code that does not belong to the state in the address.
